user.title: Rain Bird IQ4
user.description: Enter your Rain Bird IQ4 cloud account credentials.

data_description.username: If login fails with an AWS WAF challenge (HTTP 202) using your email, try your Rain Bird account name instead. This is the editable display name found under Account Settings on the IQ4 website (e.g. “John Smith”) — not the numeric “Account ID” shown in the mobile app, which won't work here.
data_description.auth_channel: How the integration logs in. Leave on "Web portal" for most accounts. Choose "Mobile app" only if zone control fails with a 403 error (e.g. US free-tier accounts).

select_controller.title: Select controller
select_controller.description: Multiple controllers were found on this account. Choose the one to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Rain Bird IQ4
reauth_confirm.description: Rain Bird refused the stored password for {username}. Enter the current password to resume. If it keeps being refused, sign in on the Rain Bird IQ4 website: the account may need a password change or new terms accepted.

error.invalid_auth: Login rejected. Check your username and password, and try signing in on the Rain Bird IQ4 website — the account may need a password change or new terms accepted.
error.waf_challenge: Rain Bird's bot protection blocked the login before it reached the sign-in form. This is not a credentials problem and is usually temporary — wait a few minutes and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check your credentials and internet connection, then try again.
error.no_controllers: No controllers were found on this account.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. See the logs for details.
error.wrong_account: This account no longer has access to this controller. To use a different account, add it as a new integration entry.

abort.reauth_successful: Reauthentication successful. The integration has been reloaded.

data.enable_realtime: Live updates over Rain Bird's real-time channel

data_description.auth_channel: How the integration logs in. Leave on "Web portal" for most accounts. Choose "Mobile app" only if zone control fails with a 403 error (e.g. US free-tier accounts). Changing this reloads the integration.
data_description.enable_realtime: Applies state changes as the controller reports them, in about a second, instead of waiting for the next poll. Only MQTT-based controllers report this way; polling continues either way. Turn this off if a firewall blocks the connection.
data_description.default_duration: How long a zone runs when its switch is turned on. To choose a different duration for a single run, use the Start Zone action.

options.web: Web portal (default) — works for most accounts
options.app: Mobile app — use if zone control fails with 403 (e.g. US free tier)
